validated_value.description: Ontology kernel for weather forecasting observations, supporting locations, forecast reports, and daily forecast records.

DailyForecast.description: A single day's forecast record containing temperature and atmospheric predictions.

day_of_week.description: Day of the week for the forecast period.

feels_like_high_temperature.description: Apparent daytime high temperature in the reported unit.

feels_like_low_temperature.description: Apparent nighttime low temperature in the reported unit.

forecast_date.description: Date label or formatted date for the forecast day.

forecast_date_id.description: Unique identifier for the daily forecast record.

high_temperature.description: Predicted daily high temperature in the reported unit.

low_temperature.description: Predicted daily low temperature in the reported unit.

temperature_unit.description: Unit of temperature measurement (e.g. C or F).

uv_index.description: Maximum UV index predicted for the day.

ForecastReport.description: A weather forecast report generated by a provider for a location and temporal range.

data_source.description: Provider or origin data source (e.g., Open-Meteo, NOAA).

elevation.description: Ground elevation of the forecasted location in meters.

forecast_days.description: Number of days covered by the forecast report.

granularity.description: Temporal granularity of the forecast (e.g., daily, hourly).

report_id.description: Identifier for the forecast report instance.

Location.description: Geographical target location defined by coordinates and optional naming.

validated_value.name: WeatherForecastOntology

for_location.description: Associates a forecast report with its target geographical location.

has_daily_forecast.description: Associates a forecast report with a specific daily forecast period.
